verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Disputes API to retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents, which covers the evidence-submission half of the story. Notification is only implied by generic webhook docs that push asynchronous outcomes instead of requiring polling; none of this evidence ties disputes specifically to in-person payments. Missing for 10: dispute- or chargeback-specific notification events, any mention of defense deadlines or deadline tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dispute workflow.
